title: Helping Digital Health Ideas Find a Path Into Care
summary: Park joined the UMZH summer school's hypertension challenge with a focus on the practical questions beyond a promising concept.

sources.label: Read Chorong Park's original LinkedIn post

paragraphs.text: Chorong Park joined the coaching program for the hypertension challenge at the second UMZH Precision Digital Therapeutics Summer School in Zurich. Her August 17, 2026, announcement outlined a role helping participants connect digital health ideas with practical care needs.

Park was scheduled to support group coaching and pre-pitch feedback on August 20, the program's implementation day. The agenda paired that work with sessions on regulation, reimbursement, business models, and putting digital interventions into practice.

Her focus was the connection between behavioral support and the conditions needed to deliver it. A compelling concept still raises questions about evidence, who could use it, and how it would fit into an existing care system.
The announcement set up the work ahead. In her subsequent August 24 reflection, Park described how teams used feedback to refine their concepts and prepare final pitches.
